verification_report.summary: The proof is correct and complete. It derives the first seven terms from the recurrence using only established nonvanishing conditions, proves every admissible sequence is 5-periodic, constructs the converse 5-periodic sequence for every admissible initial pair, and thereby establishes the claimed bijection. The inclusion-exclusion count correctly gives F(p)=(p-2)(p-3), whose value modulo 5 is 0 or 2 for every prime p>5. The statement is self-contained, all hypotheses are appropriately used, no hard prohibition is triggered, and the proof relies on no external or fact-graph references.
